note: Shared fixtures for the stage rules in curriculum/stage-rules.json. Cikgu Sensai runs them in tests/test_stage_rules.py; Kata-Kata's affix guard should run the same cases (build step 3). Each case is a list of segments checked in order as one unit sequence. expect "pass": no violation of any kind. expect "fail": at least one violation of the named check (affix, ledger, register or malaysian-form). Segment fields: text (the Malay), chapter, unit (optional; default "fixture-cNN"), kind (default "model"; "vocabulary" teaches a form, "mention" is a ‹…› quote, "test" is a test item), source_text (default text; "[spoken]" labels a spoken form), field ("prompt" or "answer_key" for kind "test"), mention_source (for kind "mention": the source text a mentions file would hold). Optional keys (Stage 2 step 6c-1): expect_gaps (terms that must be reported as ledger gaps) and expect_no_gaps (terms that must not be); a gap is not a violation, so these are checked on top of expect. Optional keys (extension rows, 15 Nov 2026): ledger_rows on a case (a list of ledger-shaped rows, at least ID, Malay, 'Kata-Kata place' and POS; other columns blank, Affix tag 'root', Review status 'Draft') are added to the ledger for that case only; a segment key extension (true) marks the segment as extension content (Kata-Kata stretch stage, a future Cikgu Sensai add-on), default false = core content. See stage-rules.json, format.extension_rows.
